identity.name: Milgauss
identity.one_liner: The green-sapphire Milgauss of 2007-2023 — the only Rolex with a tinted crystal, discontinued along with the whole line.

narrative.story: Rolex revived the Milgauss in 2007 and gave the GV version a green-tinted sapphire crystal — 'Glace Verte' — over a black, and from 2014 an electric 'Z-Blue', dial with the orange lightning-bolt seconds hand. The antimagnetic shield and caliber 3131 continued the 1950s scientist's-watch brief. When Rolex dropped the Milgauss entirely in 2023, the GV became the line's closing statement and secondary interest picked up.
narrative.collector_notes: Black-dial and Z-Blue versions trade differently; the green crystal is nearly impossible to scratch but check the case and shield-related service history. Discontinuation, not rarity, drives the current premium.
